title: Underwood says the FLIR could not have lost lock; active-duty WSO disagrees

tellings.quote: who's the Wizo who filmed it, he said, "Nope, there's no way the system would have lost it. I've talked to an active duty Wizo serving now and he said it's a finick."

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, a Navy jet filmed a white oval object shaped like the mint known as the Tic Tac, using its infrared camera pod. Chad Underwood, the back-seat weapons officer who shot the video, says there was "no way the system would have lost" track of the object, but an active-duty weapons officer says the camera is "finicky". The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff passes both views along. It matters because if the camera could lose track, the object's sudden exit in the video might just be the camera failing rather than the object speeding off.
